answer: An agent economy can resist sybils with a reciprocal credit network: influence flows only through real two-way trades. Each agent keeps a ledger of exchanges - give data, get compute - like nectar traded between flowers. Credit compounds only across diverse partners, the way an oasis is built by many travelers, not one digger. Clones shuffling tokens among themselves earn no outside history, so their influence stays trapped. Faking it means paying real fees to real strangers - carving each opal by hand: N identities need N real relationships.
